title: Security on the path to AGI
summary: At OpenAI, we proactively adapt, including by building comprehensive security measures directly into our infrastructure and models.
body: At OpenAI, we proactively adapt, including by building comprehensive security measures directly into our infrastructure and models.
summaryZh: OpenAI发表关于通往AGI道路上安全性的思考与实践，强调将全面的安全保障措施直接构建到底层基础设施和模型中，以确保前沿AI技术的可控发展。原始信息显示：At OpenAI, we proactively adapt, including by building comprehensive security measures directly into our infrastructure and models.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Security on the path to AGI”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI探讨了迈向AGI道路上的安全建设和基础设施防护。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
